about: T3.11's acceptance tests written before the implementation, by function name: contract/tests/test_t311_java.py, tests/test_t311_java_ci.py and tests/test_t311_java_process.py, read through contract/tests/t311_gate.py. Each test named in 'pending' failed when written and must still fail; once it passes it fails, naming itself, until the implementer takes it out of 'pending'. The implementer changes nothing else: 'pending' stays within 'authored', the test author's list. A parametrized test is pending as a whole. The JUnit tests under java/src/test/java/com/nvidia/sdm/ (T311*) are not listed: they run only once the implementer's pom.xml builds them, on the same commit as the code they test.
